newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian north-west telecom firms to set up a bank.
newsitem.headline: Russian north-west telecom firms to set up a bank.

text.p: Ten telecommunications companies in Russia's north west have founded an association to develop the region's communications infrastructure, association members said on Tuesday.

"The association members will tackle all issues aimed at developing north-western areas, including the establishment of a special bank," Vitaly Vitman, chief executive of AOOT Murmanskelektrosvyaz, told Reuters.
An official from AO Elektrosvyaz in Pskov region confirmed the intention to set up a joint bank.
Joint projects in the association include laying new fibre-optical cables and setting up a joint cellular phone network.

The association includes Petersburg Telephone (AOOT Sankt-Petersburgskaya Telefonnaya Set), and MMT (AO Mezhdugorodny Mezhdunarodny Telefon) from St Petersburg, AO Elektrosvyaz from Pskov, AO Cherepovets-Elektrosvyaz, AO Artelekom from Arkhangelsk, AO Murmanskelektrosvyaz, AO Elektrosvyaz from Kaliningrad, AO Novgorodtelekom, AO Elektrosvyaz from Karelia and AO Elektrosvyaz from Vologda.
State telecommunications holding company AO Svyazinvest holds controlling stakes in all members of the association.
